desc: Water spirit: a round blue-lavender orb body with three blue crystal shards on top like a crown, a gold fishing hook hanging below as a dangling tail, tiny stubby feet, gold ring on the body. An abstract spirit creature, absolutely no animal parts: no beak, wings, feathers, ears, fur or animal body. Cute chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Round black void face with two small white dot eyes. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
